name: Arduino Nano 33 BLE
description: Arduino Nano-format board with the nRF52840 (64 MHz Cortex-M4F, 1 MB flash, 256 KB RAM, Bluetooth LE) at 3.3 V logic, programmed with Arduino's Mbed core. Runs real firmware in Renode (local Docker); Bluetooth is not emulated. Pin ids are the Arduino names (D0-D13, A0-A7). Serial is USB on the real board: the simulator build prints it on Serial1 (TX D0). Wire = A4 / A5, SPI = D11 / D12 / D13 (SS D10), LED on D13, RGB LED (active low). 3.3 V logic only.

pins.label: D13/SCK
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.13; McuBackend pin "D13". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). SPI SCK, and the orange LED (LED_BUILTIN, lit when HIGH).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V out of the on-board MPM3610 buck regulator (Jumper checks against 300 mA).

pins.label: AREF
pins.description: AREF: not connected to the nRF52840 on this board (the SAADC uses its internal reference); nothing to wire.

pins.label: A0

pins.label: VUSB
pins.description: VUSB: the USB 5 V. On the real board this pin is connected only when the VUSB jumper on the back is soldered closed; Jumper models it closed.

pins.label: RST
pins.description: Reset, active LOW. Not simulated: it does not reset the emulated chip; use the Reset control.

pins.label: GND

pins.label: VIN

footprint: 45 x 18 mm, 2 x 15 pins at 0.1 in, rows 0.6 in apart (Nano format)

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply on its power pins keeps 3.3 V up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
RGB LED red (P0.24, lit when LOW) 0..1.
RGB LED green (P0.16, lit when LOW) 0..1.
RGB LED blue (P0.06, lit when LOW) 0..1.
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_D13 (only on the firmware board).

availability.reason: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-11 (packages/sim-backends/src/renode/boards.integration.test.ts: real firmware boots; every listed pin works as an output and as an input; Wire, SPI, analogRead, analogWrite, attachInterrupt and Serial reach Jumper's parts). Run with Renode 1.17.0's native build; the jumper/renode Docker image (same Renode version) could not be re-run that day because Docker Desktop was failing on the test machine.
